correctness.rationale: Define vertices of Q4 as 16 four-bit strings, edges Hamming distance 1, and Ind2 faces as induced subgraphs of maximum degree at most 1 (equivalently components of size at most 2). Independent brute-force examination of all 65,535 nonempty subsets found 3,054 simplices, f-vector (16,120,464,964,960,440,80,10), and 1,518 pairs from the specified 16-pivot sequence. The entire oriented 13,568 Hasse-incidence graph topologically sorted all 3,054 nonempty simplices: exactly one critical vertex, sixteen critical 3-simplices and one critical 4-simplex. An independently implemented exact signed integral Morse-boundary projection of the critical 4-cell onto the sixteen 3-cells returned zero (not just mod 2). Thus the 3-skeleton of the Morse CW model is ∨16S3, which is 2-connected; Hurewicz π3≅H3 makes zero cellular degree imply the 4-cell attaches nullhomotopically, yielding (∨16S3)∨S4. This is a particular finite Q4 statement, not a general hypercube formula. C4□C4 graph isomorphic to Q4.

evidence: Foundational classifications cover paths, cycles, complete multipartite, whiskered and certain trees; chordal/trees are inapplicable because Q4 has induced four-cycles.
broader_coverage.reasoning: No applicable general theorem in inspected categories yields this exact Q4 Ind2 homotopy. An all-graph identity has not been found or asserted absent worldwide.

value.rationale: Two-independence is a natural established graph-complex functor, and the smallest nontrivial toroidal 4×4 hypercube is a canonical finite benchmark beyond tree, cycle, chordal and complete multipartite classes. The genuinely mixed 16S3+S4 integral homotopy type requires an exact integer attaching-degree check; a mod-two Betti table alone would not supply it. This exact invariant is motivated and potentially reusable for larger periodic-grid comparisons.
